title: Ball falls into water, creating ripples while a character follows the mouse
summary: A sparse hand-drawn interactive scene concept on lined paper. A ball sits high near the upper-left with a note indicating it drops slowly. A smiling character on the left is annotated to chase the mouse. Near the bottom-left is a horizontal water surface labeled WATER, with a note explaining that when the ball enters the water, ripples spread. In red, a central motion diagram reinforces the sequence: BALL falls downward into WATER, producing ripple waves to the right.

relations.description: The ball is intended to move downward.
The arrow accompanies the note that the ball falls slowly.
The label names the smiling face as the character.
The note describes the character's behavior.
The text identifies the horizontal line as water.
The note explains what happens when the ball enters the water.
The red sequence shows the ball falling downward.
The falling ball reaches the water.
Water leads to the next depicted effect.
The arrow points to the resulting ripple effect.
The text names the wave marks as ripples.
The ball is intended to eventually fall into the water.
The ball entering the water causes ripples to spread.
The character and ball appear in the same scene, though no direct drawn link connects them.

interactions.description: The ball gradually descends toward the water.
When the ball hits or enters the water, ripple waves spread outward.
The character is intended to chase the mouse pointer.

notes: Composition is sparse with large empty space.
Objects are separated like idea notes rather than a polished layout.
Red ink is used as an explanatory motion/effect diagram distinct from the pencil scene.
The hand-drawn asymmetry and notebook-paper context feel important to the concept.

ambiguities: It is unclear whether the red BALL/WATER/ripple diagram is a separate explanatory inset or part of the same main scene.
The exact starting position and path of the ball relative to the water surface are conceptual rather than precisely drawn.
The character's role beyond following the mouse is unspecified; it may be decorative, reactive, or playable.
Ripple direction is described as spreading, but the red example emphasizes rightward progression rather than symmetric circles.
